points.description: States that the negative electrode is made of hydrogen absorbing alloys (metal hydride, MH), e.g. hydrogen-storage alloy such as LaNi5/AB5-type; synonyms like 'metal hydride alloy' or 'hydrogen storage alloy' accepted.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark for a vague or half-correct answer, e.g. just 'metal hydride' or 'alloy' / 'hydrogen absorbing material' without alloy or metal hydride link.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for hydrogen absorbing alloy / metal hydride (MH) / hydrogen storage alloy in any wording. Give 1 mark if only part of the idea is given, such as just 'alloy', 'metal' or 'hydrogen absorbing material'. Give 0 for wrong materials such as nickel hydroxide, cadmium, or lead, which is the positive electrode or a different battery.
